info.title: dt-asyncapi: lint AsyncAPI documents against the Digitals rules.
info.description: Lints any AsyncAPI 2 or 3 document against the Digitals event API rules. Bundles Spectral, so it needs nothing else installed.

commands.name: docs
commands.description: Write the contract as a documentation page

commands.name: lint
commands.description: Fail when the document breaks a rule

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version number  [boolean]

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help  [boolean]

options.name: --encoding
options.description: text encoding to use  [string] [choices: "utf8", "ascii", "utf-8", "utf16le", "ucs2", "ucs-2", "base64", "latin1"] [default: "utf8"]

options.name: --format
options.description: formatters to use for outputting results, more than one can be provided by using multiple flags  [string] [choices: "json", "stylish", "junit", "html", "text", "teamcity", "pretty", "github-actions", "sarif", "code-climate", "gitlab", "markdown"] [default: "stylish"]

options.name: --output
options.description: where to output results, can be a single file name, multiple "output.<format>" or missing to print to stdout  [string]

options.name: --stdin-filepath
options.description: path to a file to pretend that stdin comes from  [string]

options.name: --resolver
options.description: path to custom json-ref-resolver instance  [string]

options.name: --ruleset
options.description: path/URL to a ruleset file  [string]

options.name: --fail-severity
options.description: results of this level or above will trigger a failure exit code  [string] [choices: "error", "warn", "info", "hint"] [default: "error"]

options.name: --display-only-failures
options.description: only output results equal to or greater than --fail-severity  [boolean] [default: false]

options.name: --ignore-unknown-format
options.description: do not warn about unmatched formats  [boolean] [default: false]

options.name: --fail-on-unmatched-globs
options.description: fail on unmatched glob patterns  [boolean] [default: false]

options.name: --show-documentation-url
options.description: show documentation url in output result  [boolean] [default: false]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: increase verbosity  [boolean]

options.name: --quiet
options.description: no logging - output only  [boolean]
